publication: Morocco, Bulletin Officiel no. 6306, French official translation, 6 November 2014, Decree 2-13-874, thermal regulation annex, printed page 4265.
source_host: Moroccan National Electricity Regulation Authority. Official gazette reproduction.
sample: Fifteen independently scored numeric obligations, five table cells each from three adjacent residential prescriptive rows. These are not fifteen distinct numbered articles. Solar cells are the Other-orientations limb applied to known non-north glazing. The north limb is outside the fixture.
selection: Z3, Z4, Z5; all residential TGBV 26–35% rows, first four numeric columns and one non-north solar column. No modeling outputs informed selection or truth.
scope: Three new urban residential buildings on the prescriptive path, independently identified as Z3, Z4 and Z5, each with 30% TGBV, one uniform assembly per category and a single non-north glazing type. No exception is asserted. Applicable pairs are each row against its own building.

roof_u: Roof assembly thermal calculation, exposed roof
window_u: Window test certificate or verified whole-window specification
slab_r: Résistance thermique R des planchers sur sol
solar: Facteur solaire FS du vitrage hors nord
Glazing specification and applicable shading calculation
